parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description: Filters by the product type of the resource. If this parameter is not specified, all types are queried.

parameters.name: ResourceOwnerIds
parameters.description: The list of resource owner IDs. This parameter is used in cross-account scenarios. If this parameter is left empty, data of the current account is returned by default.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: Filters by the region where the resource resides. If this parameter is not specified, all regions are queried.
